crossRefs.note: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.
“Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

translations.web: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
translations.bsb: One day, however, Joseph went into the house to attend to his work, and not a single household servant was inside.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house
translations.asv: And it came to pass about this time, that he went into the house to do his work; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
